description: This is a header file (.h) for the 'sm_report' module, defining the interface for report handling in a Wi-Fi management software component. It includes function declarations for report tasks, initialization, deinitialization, and push operations for client, survey, and neighbor reports, as well as includes for related headers.

methods.name: sm_report_start_task
methods.description: Starts the reporting task for specified stats type with given application context.

methods.name: sm_report_config_task
methods.description: Configures the reporting task with provided application and stats request state.

methods.name: sm_report_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes report module for the specified application.

methods.name: sm_report_init
methods.description: Initializes report module for the specified application.

methods.name: sm_report_send_to_qm_cb
methods.description: Callback to send report data to the quality monitor queue.

methods.name: survey_report_counter_publish_cb
methods.description: Callback for publishing survey report counters.

methods.name: sm_client_report_push_to_dpp
methods.description: Pushes client report data to DPP (Data Path Processor) for a specific frequency band and channel.

methods.name: sm_survey_report_push_to_dpp
methods.description: Pushes survey report data to DPP for a specific survey type, report type, and frequency band.

methods.name: sm_neighbor_report_push_to_dpp
methods.description: Pushes neighbor report data to DPP for a specific survey type, report type, and frequency band.
